note: Golden example candidates for the Style Guide (docs/STYLE.md, 'Golden examples'). They are the best placeholder art so far; the M2 art direction call confirms or replaces them. The starter kit zip includes these files next to the palette and templates.

examples.shows: A player character: Player 1 ramp on robe and hat, Skin face, Wood staff, feet about 2-3 px above the bottom edge
An enemy: Fire body, Bone horns and Spark eyes, no player colour, a bold silhouette
A raised tile: lit top and left edge, shaded bottom and right edge
A flat tile: Stone base, a few inner details, nothing on the outer edge so it repeats
A projectile: a streak in Fire materials with a Spark core, outlined in its own shadow shade
An impact: a flat burst in Spark materials, over in 0.2 s
